item.title: Grocery Store Coming To Downtown Fort Wayne
item.description: Plans for a long-awaited downtown grocery store were announced during the 2026 State of the City address in Fort Wayne, with city leaders and developers outlining a project aimed at expanding food access for residents in the urban core.

item.title: Kosciusko’s Dancing with the Stars for Charity 2026 Rehearsals underway
item.description: The music has started, the dance shoes are on, and rehearsals are officially underway for the fourth annual Dancing with the Stars for Charity, 7 p.m. Saturday, March 28, at the Warsaw Performing Arts Center.

item.title: Syracuse Family Asking For Help Finding Pet
item.description: A family in Syracuse is asking for help to find their missing dog.

item.title: Indiana Duck, Turkey Farms Detect Avian Flu
item.description: Highly pathogenic avian influenza has been detected again at a commercial poultry operation in northern Indiana, affecting a meat duck facility in Elkhart County with more than 10,700 birds, according to the Indiana State Board of Animal Health.

item.title: Rochester Man Arrested On Criminal Recklessness, Domestic Battery Charges

item.title: Fairfield wins fourth regional title in nine years
item.description: Basketball success keeps piling up for the Fairfield Lady Falcons after they defeated Kankakee Valley 49-47 Saturday, Feb. 14, in the Winamac Regional.
